method: Manual browser controller user E2E through run.sh-launched application, real gpt-6-luna, public live Cosmetics/Olist warehouse; no direct API substitutes for UI actions
budget: UI server launched through ignored local shared-budget wrapper; ordinary run.sh does not enable this wrapper automatically
judgement: Core explicit single-source queries work on observed samples. Not ready to claim unrestricted class demo: Vietnamese followup classification fails for common phrases; home suggestions exceed scope. No class-scale load test.
no_aggregate_accuracy: Purposeful small UX sample, correlated turns; do not treat pass rate as benchmark accuracy.
